description: This file defines an abstract serializer class for business events with custom data in the Fineract project. It includes methods for collecting custom data from event serializers.

classes.name: AbstractBusinessEventWithCustomDataSerializer
classes.description: An abstract class providing a structure for serializing business events with custom data serializers.

methods.name: collectCustomData
methods.description: Collects custom serializable data from all registered external event custom data serializers.

methods.name: getExternalEventCustomDataSerializers
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a list of serializers responsible for serializing custom data.
